en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. In the foreground three boys sit and fish from a grassy bank beside a calm river. Across the water there is a line of tall trees and behind them a small town with tiled roofs and walls. The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard. In the upper left corner is German text giving the place name and location by the river.
